questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I forget to cancel contracts on time, like trial subscriptions for newspapers.
questions.platformChinese: 我会忘记在截止日期前取消合约，比如报纸的试订服务。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I remember to run errands that need to be completed within a specific timeframe, like picking up my laundry from the dry cleaner before it closes.
questions.platformChinese: 我会记得在规定时间内办好事情，比如在干洗店关门前取回衣物。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: If I´ve borrowed something from someone for a while, I remember to give it back to that person the next time we see each other.
questions.platformChinese: 如果向别人借东西有一段时间了，下次见面时我会记得还给对方。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I forget to call a friend again after I couldn´t reach him or her on the first try.
questions.platformChinese: 第一次没打通朋友的电话后，我会忘记再打一次。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I receive overdue notifications because I forget to pay bills on time.
questions.platformChinese: 我会因为忘记按时支付账单而收到催缴通知。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I am able to remind myself of phone calls I need to make, such as calling a friend on his or her birthday.
questions.platformChinese: 我能够自己想起还没打的电话，比如今天需要给过生日的朋友打电话。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I remember my appointments which are coming up in a few days without writing them down.
questions.platformChinese: 即使没有写下来，我也会及时想起这几天要赴的约。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I don´t send e-mails or letters on time, even when I wrote myself a reminder to do so.
questions.platformChinese: 即使已经写下提醒，我还是没能按时发出该发的邮件或信件。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: Even when I´m busy doing other things, I deliberately try to keep unfinished tasks in mind so that I don´t forget them.
questions.platformChinese: 即使正在忙别的事，我也会有意识地反复想着还没做完的事情，以免忘记。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: In the morning, I go through the day‘s tasks in my head so that I don´t forget to remember something.
questions.platformChinese: 早上我会在脑中把当天要做的事情过一遍，以免忘记。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: When I have to complete steps in a specific order, such as when I am baking, I visualize the sequence of steps before starting.
questions.platformChinese: 如果有几件事需要按顺序完成，比如烘焙，我会在开始前想象整个步骤。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: After completing a task, I check once again whether I took care of everything, like turning off the stove after cooking.
questions.platformChinese: 做完一件事后，我会再检查是否都处理好了，比如做完饭后是否关了炉灶。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: In my mind, I make a list of things that I still have to complete.
questions.platformChinese: 我会在脑中列一份还有哪些事情没做的清单。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I think of my to-do list while I am busy doing something else, like washing dishes or working out.
questions.platformChinese: 忙着做其他事情时，比如洗碗或运动，我会在脑中回想待办清单。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: Before I go shopping, I picture where the products I need are located in the store, so that I don´t forget to pick them up when I walk through the aisles.
questions.platformChinese: 购物前，我会想象需要的商品在店里的什么位置，以免经过货架时忘记拿。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I write myself a to-do list to remind me of things that I still need to accomplish.
questions.platformChinese: 我会写一份待办清单，提醒自己还有哪些事情要做。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I write shopping lists.
questions.platformChinese: 我会写购物清单。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: When I have to take something with me the next morning, like a letter or a library book, I put it in my bag the evening before so that I won´t forget it the next day.
questions.platformChinese: 第二天早上要带的东西，比如信件或借的图书，我会在前一晚放进包里，以免早上忘记。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I keep a calendar with all of my appointments.
questions.platformChinese: 我会用日历记下所有约定和安排。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: To help me remember to do things, I stick "Post-It " notes in obvious places.
questions.platformChinese: 我会把写有待办事项的便条贴在显眼的地方，提醒自己。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I put things in prominent places so that I´m reminded of tasks I need to do (for example, putting a full trash bag in front of the door so I don´t forget to take it out).
questions.platformChinese: 我会把物品放在显眼的位置，提醒自己要做的事，比如把装满的垃圾袋放在门口，以免忘记拿出去。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: For things that I need to do on a regular basis, I plan to do them at the same time each day (for example, always taking my medication in the evening before brushing my teeth).
questions.platformChinese: 对于需要定期做的事情，我会安排在每天同一时间做，比如每天晚上刷牙前服药。
